title: 氷結保管庫の調律師たち ―溶けない記憶と、二つの季節―
author: 野分 風太

en.title: Tuners of the Cryogenic Vault: Unmelting Memories and Two Seasons
en.premise: A story of specialized refrigeration engineers tasked with managing 'organic matter of historical value'—substances that would disintegrate if not kept at ultra-low temperatures. As a newcomer, I begin to learn the uncompromising professional standards of the experts who handle these frozen relics. One day, within the massive main freezer, which stands like a castle of ice, an unexplained sample left behind by twin researchers is discovered. It poses a profound question: will it fill the voids in history, or freeze the current order in its tracks?

zh.title: 冰封保管库的调律师们 ——不融化的记忆与两个季节——
zh.premise: 这是一个关于特殊制冷技术人员的故事，他们负责管理那些若非处于极低温环境下就会崩坏的“具有历史价值的有机物”。作为一名新人，我逐渐领悟着那些处理冻结遗物的专家们绝不妥协的工作准则。某一天，在如冰之城堡般巨大的主冷库中，发现了一个由双胞胎研究员留下的未解样本。它提出了一个重大的课题：究竟是填补历史的空白，还是冻结现有的秩序？
